senses.gloss: הִשְׁתִּין (b. h.; , Ges. Thes. s. v.), with, or sub. מים, to urinate.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:6">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>ביקש להַשְׁתִּין מים ולא ה׳</he> needed to make water, and forewent it.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67b:11">Sabb. 67ᵇ</cite> (a superstitious custom) <he>המַשְׁתֶּנֶת בפני וכ׳</he> who urinates before her pot that it may boil quickly; a. fr.
